name: Bash
note: Manually reviewed complete actual command, executable/arguments, operators, pipes, quoting, redirects, path operands and full returned content. Only grep/sed/find/ls/cat/head/echo/pwd source reads or source-local navigation occur here. No eval, network command, zg CLI, project execution or source write. Search patterns/code/test text are data. Failed or empty source probes remain in original evidence and no per-stage status is inferred from whole-tool success.
